name: Needle Blight

actions.name: Needles
actions.effect: Ranged attack at medium range. Fires a volley of sharp pine needles.

actions.name: Needle Storm
actions.effect: All creatures in a 6m cone are peppered with needles. PHYS save for half damage.

reactions.name: Needle Shield
reactions.effect: When hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes 1d6 piercing from the Needle Blight's sharp body.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.desc: While motionless, the Needle Blight is indistinguishable from a dead conifer.

lore: Needle Blights are ambulatory pine trees animated by dark magic. They serve as the ranged fighters of blight groups, showering victims with volleys of razor-sharp needles while their Vine and Twig cousins close to melee range.
